crm_notes: Lead profile: early-stage B2B SaaS (SaaS-native) building in-app chat assistant for their product support and onboarding flows.
Primary ask: low-latency streaming chat (client-side streaming for immediate token display) + low integration friction (JS SDK), want to keep on hosted plan initially.
Latency target: interactive UX — target <250ms p95 token delivery for short turns; overall response start <500ms for common prompts. Concerned about p95 spikes with cold kv cache.
Throughput: expects 50-150 concurrent active users in NA initially, seasonal spikes to ~400. Budget-conscious; wants guidance on batching/cost tradeoffs.
Models: prefers open models / Redwood-verified lightweight variants. Interested in smaller quantized models for cost, but wants quality baseline for follow-ups.
Security: SOC2 required for sales conversations; SSO/SAML not required for MVP but will be blocker for mid-market buyers. Data residency not required now.
Quote from CTO on 2/22: 'We need streaming to feel instant — anything above 300ms starts to feel sluggish in our UI.'
Integration notes: frontend uses React + WebSocket-based streaming; backend uses Node server for orchestration. Wants sample SDK snippet and replayable test harness.
Requested artifacts: pricing deck, streaming quickstart sample, example token-cost report for 100k messages/month, SLA summary for hosted tier.
POC ask: 2-week POC with up to 3 model variants, telemetry hooks to show latency/cost per route, simple canary fallback to cheaper model under load.
Sales angle: typical SMB self-serve → potential expansion to Dedicated if they grow and need stricter isolation / predictable high concurrency.
Potential upsell: Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/cache to reduce token spend; later Dedicated if they want committed capacity.
Notes for SE: propose streaming websocket example, show prefix caching and sample batching policies; run short load test with customer's test harness (client-sim).
Internal: pricing sensitivity flagged — mark as ask for 6mo startup promo credits. Keep touch cadence weekly during POC.
